item.title: usefulwaves 0.0.33
item.description: - Add optional usage analytics and crash reporting. Each setting starts off. - Enable local MCP reads for saved captures, meetings, and QA reviews by default. Saved choices still apply. - Group local MCP and reporting under Data and privacy in General. Simplify General and Dictation settings.

item.title: usefulwaves 0.0.34
item.description: - Prevent a late audio configuration notice from restarting a healthy microphone during dictation. - Center dictation recovery actions and shorten warning copy to fit both overlay sizes. - Group the microphone test, sound preview, volume, and playback device in Dictation settings. - Request low reasoning for dictation and Quick Actions. Request medium reasoning for meeting analysis and QA summaries. - Use ASD-STE100 as the default guidance for clear English prose.
